card.name: Quantifier words before a stated finding
card.fires_on: Words that set up a result or extent, such as "almost" before "all", "show" before "no bias", or "trials" after "In these". They sit right before the main finding is stated.

modes.label: Degree words
modes.description: "Almost" or similar degree words that come before "all" or "universally".
modes.example: the amino acids found in living things are<< almost>> universally "left-handed."
